name: wechat-article-studio
description: Turn raw reading notes / transcripts / outlines into a ready-to-publish WeChat Official Account article package: serialized articles, copy-ready styled HTML, shareable cards, Word docs (on request), a publishing playbook, and per-article publish kits (field sheet + body HTML + cover + checklist) for semi-automatic posting without API access.

displayDescription.en: Turns raw notes and transcripts into a full WeChat package: serialized articles, copy-ready HTML, share cards, Word docs on request, a publishing guide, and per-article publish kits.
displayDescription.zh: 读书笔记、逐字稿加工成可发布公众号全套：成稿、图文HTML、卡片、发布手册，并打包一键发布含封面。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我会给你一份原始材料（读书笔记/逐字稿/脑图）和来源声明口径，请把它加工成一套可直接发布的公众号内容。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I'll give you raw source material (reading notes / transcript / mind map) plus a source-attribution line. Turn it into a ready-to-publish WeChat article package.

quickPrompts.en: I'll give you raw source material (reading notes / transcript / mind map) plus a source-attribution line. Turn it into a ready-to-publish WeChat article package.
quickPrompts.zh: 我会给你一份原始材料（读书笔记/逐字稿/脑图）和来源声明口径，请把它加工成一套可直接发布的公众号内容。

quickPrompts.en: Here are my reading notes and the source-attribution wording. Produce the serialized articles, the copy-ready styled HTML, share cards, and a per-article publish kit (field sheet + body HTML + cover + checklist).
quickPrompts.zh: 这是我的读书笔记和来源声明口径，请产出系列成稿、图文一体排版HTML、干货卡片，并为每篇打包一键发布包（字段表+正文HTML+封面+操作清单）。

quickPrompts.en: Turn this transcript into WeChat articles: reader-pain-point angle, golden-line subheadings, action checklists, and a fixed source declaration at the end of every piece.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这份逐字稿改成公众号文章：读者痛点视角、金句小标题、落地动作清单，每篇文末固定带来源声明。
